Container.Name: invoice-collector-MongoDB
Container.Overview: MongoDB is a cross-platform document-oriented NoSQL database. This container provides the MongoDB database backend required by invoice-collector. It must run on the same Docker network invoice-collector_internal.
Container.Requires: Requires invoice-collector container to run on the same Docker network "invoice-collector_internal". IMPORTANT: Before adding this container, create the Docker network first. 1. Open Unraid Terminal 2. Run: docker network create invoice-collector_internal 3. Go to Settings > Docker 4. Disable Docker and click Apply 5. Enable "Preserve user defined networks" and click Apply 6. Re-enable Docker MongoDB configuration: - Container name: invoice-collector-MongoDB - Hostname: mongodb - Network: invoice-collector_internal - Database port: 27017 (internal only) The invoice-collector container connects using DATABASE_URI=mongodb://mongodb:27017

Config.Name: Hostname
Config.Description: Docker hostname used by invoice-collector for database connectivity.
